summary.text: Jacob Weinberg is the Democratic candidate for Arizona House of Representatives District 13 (2 seats) in the November 3, 2026 general election, after advancing from the Democratic primary on July 21, 2026.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a U.S. Army combat veteran and the chief financial officer of an Arizona technology solutions company.

paragraphs.text: Jacob Weinberg earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Arizona in 2005 and graduate degrees from the University of Illinois in 2012 and Harvard University in 2025, according to Ballotpedia.
Ballotpedia lists him as having served in the U.S. Army since 2005 and as working as a chief financial officer.

In the survey, Weinberg said he was commissioned into the Army after September 11, served in the 82nd Airborne Division and in the Iraq War, and has served in the National Guard for 17 years at the rank of lieutenant colonel.
He said he was an auditor for 15 years and became a CPA.
He listed water supply, cutting fraud, waste and abuse from the state budget, and ending subsidies and tax breaks he said go to those taking the state's resources among his priorities.
